subject: Finalizing ledger cutover: staggered payments, wire routing and EU VAT question
messages:
From: Tom Mercer <tom.mercer@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finance@bluewavehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: PO and question on invoice timing

Hi Vivek,

Attached our PO (BW_PO_4591.pdf) for the renewal term. We reviewed the proposed invoice split and want to propose a slightly different staging: 60% on contract start, 40% 30 days later. Our treasury team labels the second tranche as a contingent wire — they call it "payment privilege" when it requires internal approvals.

Before we sign, two quick asks: 1) can Redwood issue two legal invoices with the exact amounts and separate invoice numbers? 2) We're based in Ireland — does Redwood expect us to apply the EU reverse-charge for VAT or will you issue an invoice with VAT included? If you need any tax paperwork from us, flag it.

Thanks,
Tom Mercer
Head of Finance — Bluewave Health
[attachment: BW_PO_4591.pdf (pdf, 56KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Mercer <tom.mercer@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: PO and question on invoice timing

Tom — thanks for sending the PO and for the clear staging proposal. We can absolutely issue two separate invoices with distinct invoice numbers and wire instructions. A few notes up front: 

- We typically support a 2-tranche split (works with our ledger cutover) — please confirm the exact amounts you want for 60% / 40% and the preferred date for the 2nd tranche (you suggested 30 days).
- On VAT: Redwood will *not* charge VAT on B2B cross-border EU transactions when the reverse-charge applies — but we need your VAT registration number and an EU tax cert or confirmation to apply reverse-charge on our invoice. If Bluewave prefers Redwood to charge VAT, we can do that but it will change the totals.
- "Payment privilege": understood term. If the second tranche requires internal sign-offs on your side, we'll mark that invoice as "Due on receipt — contingent payment" in the description and keep ledger timing flexible.

I'll loop in Marissa to prepare the invoice templates and Karthik for tax verification. Can you also share Sarah Woods (accounts) as the accounting contact and any tax doc PDFs?

Next steps: Marissa to draft two invoice stubs, Karthik to confirm reverse-charge prerequisites. Vivek to confirm wire routing once paperwork is in.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue — Redwood Inference

From: Tom Mercer <tom.mercer@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Woods <sarah.woods@bluewavehealth.com>, finance@bluewavehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-28T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: PO and question on invoice timing

Vivek — attaching the tax docs you asked for and confirming contacts.

- Amounts: 60% = EUR 90,000; 40% = EUR 60,000.
- Second tranche target: 2027-05-27 (30 days after start).
- Accounting contact: Sarah Woods (sarah.woods@bluewavehealth.com).
- Attachments: Bluewave_TaxCert_EU.pdf (VAT registration proof), contact card for Sarah.

Let me know if you need anything else. We prefer reverse-charge if Redwood is able to produce a zero-VAT invoice with the right reference.

Thanks,
Tom
[attachment: Bluewave_TaxCert_EU.pdf (pdf, 38KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Mercer <tom.mercer@bluewavehealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Draft invoice split and invoice metadata (for acceptance)

Tom / team — pulling together the invoice stubs now. Per our template we'll produce: 

1) RDW-INV-2027-04-27-01 — EUR 90,000 — Due on receipt — Wire instructions enclosed.
2) RDW-INV-2027-05-15-02 — EUR 60,000 — Due on receipt (marked with note: "payment privilege — subject to Bluewave approvals").

Two small points: 
- Karthik: please confirm whether separate invoice dates (Apr 27 and May 15) are preferable or whether we should use Apr 27 and May 27 to match Bluewave's requested 30-day timing.
- Tom: we need the VAT number line exactly as you want it on the invoice so the reverse-charge reference is correct. Example line we add: "VAT reverse charge applies — VAT ID: IE1234567V."

Attachments you'll see shortly: invoice stubs (PDF), and a wire routing confirmation doc. Priyom will run the final credit hold and mark the second invoice with the payment privilege note so operations knows the second tranche may be delayed.

Marissa Cole
Senior Billing Manager — Redwood Inference
[attachment: RDW-invoice-GB-2027-04-27.pdf (stub, 12KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Mercer <tom.mercer@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft invoice split and invoice metadata (for acceptance)

All — quick tax check from finance: Bluewave's EU VAT cert looks valid, but we need a formal confirmation of the buyer's VAT ID to print on the invoice and a short email from the buyer confirming they will self-account under Article 194 (reverse charge) — this is standard evidence for our auditors. Tom, can Sarah send a line like: "Bluewave Health VAT ID IE1234567V — we will apply reverse-charge for this B2B purchase"?

Also, if Bluewave requires the second tranche to be tagged as "payment privilege," Priyom — please flag the accounts receivable entry and set a 7-day follow-up cadence post-due date so the collection team can escalate if approvals don't clear.

Karthik Iyer
Finance Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Mercer <tom.mercer@bluewavehealth.com>, Sarah Woods <sarah.woods@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal ledger cutover — confirm final steps and sign-off

Tom / Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround and the VAT doc. Summary and next actions (please reply with a one-line approval so we can issue final invoices):

1) Invoice schedule and amounts confirmed: RDW-INV-2027-04-27-01 (EUR 90,000) and RDW-INV-2027-05-15-02 (EUR 60,000).
2) Bluewave will self-account under reverse-charge. Sarah, please reply with the confirmation line requested by Karthik so we have audit evidence.
3) Wire instructions: we will include the full routing on the first invoice PDF; second invoice will reference the same bank but will carry the "payment privilege" note.
4) Attachments posted to our shared Drive folder for bookkeeping: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-invoices-bluewave

If I don't hear a one-line approval from Sarah by EOD Friday 2027-05-07 we will proceed to issue the first invoice only and hold the second as draft until Bluewave confirms.

Appreciate the collaboration — once invoices issue we'll drop the payment references into the HubSpot deal record.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue — Redwood Inference
[attachment: RDW-invoice-GB-2027-05-15.pdf (stub, 10KB)]
